description: Enhanced skip-in-context cases: a URL whose path contains misspelled-looking text is masked while a following ordinary misspelling is still flagged, and an email address is masked while a following misspelling is flagged. Each reported misspelling is its UTF-8 start byte offset, end byte offset, and text, one per line, ordered by position. The request is {"op":"spellcheck","text":<text>,"lang":"text"}.
